feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: Xenia 0.1.1
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: ten touchscreen pages, ROM banks and patch browser, assignable play knobs and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: Osirus 0.2.9
entry.summary: An emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C synthesizers' original firmware (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and patch browser, Q-Link control and knob values on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Virus ROM.

entry.title: Monomodule One + FX 1.0.2
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument, plus its 7 effect machines as an audio effect, each with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.2
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's synth engine (15 machines) as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and preset lists, and Q-Links. A ready-made download: nothing of Elektron's is in the zip; you put your own Monomachine OS file in the plugin folder and it makes its skin and sound from that. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Monomodule FX (Gen2) 1.0.2
entry.summary: The Elektron Monomachine's seven effect machines (thru, reverb, chorus, dynamix, ring mod, phaser, flanger) as an audio effect for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: it reads your own Monomachine OS file from the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Mini-JV 1.0.9
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Machinemodule Tap (Gen2) 1.0.1
entry.summary: Puts any Machinemodule tracks, and its reverb and delay sends, on their own MPC return or FX track, so MPC's mixer and effects can process them. Needs Machinemodule in the same project. Gen2 (aarch64) only.

entry.title: Machinemodule (Gen2) 1.0.1
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum UW sound engine as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: 16 tracks in one plugin, touchscreen skin, bank and kit lists, Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: you add your own OS file (and optionally your flash image) in the plugin folder. Gen2 only.

entry.title: Machinemodule 1.0.1
entry.summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: KutilXXL 0.2.1
entry.summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables across three screens: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP plus Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC. Tap a module to open a window with just its jacks, big and named, and patch between modules.

entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.7
entry.summary: Ten-voice wavetable synthesizer modelled exactly on the Microwave II/XT with a ten-page touchscreen skin and Q-Links. Needs your own ROM files in its ROMS folder.

entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with three preamp characters, chorus, tape wear, tempo sync with drift, a spring reverb and a companion screen in the browser.

entry.title: πClideaN MPC 1.3.0
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: VADER 0.9.0 (beta)
entry.summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, 35 maths shapes, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) or one of 27 modes across four corners. Each corner plays overtone generators, one of 14 voices, or a WAV sample. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects. Its screen runs on your phone: scan the QR code, load shapes from the phone too.

entry.title: SubWerk 0.0.10
entry.summary: Analog-style monosynth in the spirit of a 37-key American paraphonic classic: two morphing oscillators with hard sync, sub and noise, a feedback mixer, a 4-pole ladder filter with Multidrive, two looping envelopes, glide and Duo. 57 presets and a six-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: RMXXXL 1.3.0
entry.summary: RMX-1000-style remix effect: isolator, DJ filter, Build Up / Break Down scenes, synced echo, Release FX and a Release kill switch, EQ Kill buttons, a clean Panic, Clouds, Dragonfly reverbs, sample pads with ADSR, 16 user presets and a brickwall limiter, with a big-button touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: PolyWerk 0.0.6
entry.summary: Eight-voice wavetable synth: two wavetable oscillators with 8x unison and subs, 30 built-in tables plus your own Serum-format WAVs, two filters with comb and vowel, two LFOs, a 12-slot mod matrix, arpeggiator and sequencers, 205 presets and a seven-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: GHOST 2.4.2 (beta)
entry.summary: Live buffer manipulation, rhythmic stutter and generative glitch with independent and combined Random Repeat modes.

entry.title: EffectWerk 0.0.5
entry.summary: A live looper and performance mixer in one insert slot: record bars on MPC's grid, then roll, slow, reverse and layer them, and crossfade two scenes from 64 one-tap effects. Plus a ten-module effect rack with macros, LFOs and a mod matrix, 62 presets and a 14-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: DINXXL 1.0.0
entry.summary: BlastBeats-style OPL3 FM groovebox: the published v7.1 firmware by Twisted Electrons runs unmodified on a software model of its board (YMF262 via ymfm). 6 drums, 4 four-op synths, 64-step sequencer with p-locks and songs, factory card inside. By L'Cronx; not made or endorsed by Twisted Electrons.

entry.title: Clif Tape 0.2.0
entry.summary: Stereo tape colour and digital degradation, expressive Wow/Flutter, twelve tone profiles, crackle, stereo spread, independent noise textures and Silence Gate. Fifteen presets and touchscreen Q-Links.

entry.title: Cadenza 0.25.0
entry.summary: Chord-driven generative MIDI sequencer: pick a key and scale, shape chords, bass and melody with a few knobs per page, and it generates and follows along as you play.
